subject.title: feat(runner): support OpenClaw plugins across the ClawHub profile

question: Should ClawScan’s new `plugin` target promise compatibility with every manifest accepted by OpenClaw, including JSON5-only manifests, or intentionally establish and document a narrower strict-JSON scan contract?
rationale: Either choice sets a public compatibility boundary for valid OpenClaw plugins; the mechanically preferable implementation depends on whether maintainers accept the added parser dependency and parity commitment.

options.title: Match OpenClaw JSON5 compatibility
options.body: Accept the same JSON5 fallback used by OpenClaw and add regression fixtures, so host-valid plugin manifests remain scannable.

options.title: Keep strict JSON as an explicit boundary
options.body: Retain strict parsing only if maintainers intentionally accept that some host-valid plugins cannot be scanned and narrow the feature/docs accordingly.

recommendation.title: Match OpenClaw JSON5 compatibility
recommendation.body: Accept the same JSON5 fallback used by OpenClaw and add regression fixtures, so host-valid plugin manifests remain scannable.

likelyOwner.reason: Requested code-owner review is the strongest available signal for the manifest contract decision.
